description: This file sets up authentication routes for a Node.js Express backend, primarily handling Steam OAuth login via Passport.js, including configuration, route handlers for login, callback, session info, and logout, with support for demo users when Steam integration is not configured.

methods.name: serializeUser
methods.description: Configures how user objects are serialized into sessions for Passport.js

methods.name: deserializeUser
methods.description: Configures how user objects are deserialized from sessions for Passport.js

methods.name: SteamStrategy
methods.description: Passport.js strategy for Steam OAuth2 login

methods.name: router.get('/steam/return')
methods.description: Steam OAuth callback route to handle login response

methods.name: router.get('/dev-login')
methods.description: Development-only route for demo login when Steam is not configured

methods.name: router.get('/session')
methods.description: Returns current session user info and balance

methods.name: router.post('/logout')
methods.description: Logs out user by clearing session

methods.name: router.get('/logout')
methods.description: Convenience route for logout via GET
